plan_a_advantages: Includes a dedicated threshold interval session.
Features a longer, more focused long run for endurance.
Incorporates cross-training for recovery and injury prevention.
plan_b_advantages: Hill repeats provide a good strength stimulus.
The overall volume of training is slightly higher, potentially leading to greater overall mileage.
reasoning: For a runner aiming to become faster, Plan A is the superior choice. It incorporates a crucial interval session to specifically target threshold pace, a key determinant of running speed. Plan B, while including hill repeats, lacks this focused speed development work. Furthermore, Plan A’s longer, dedicated long run (108 minutes) is more aligned with building the sustained endurance necessary for trail racing, whereas Plan B’s long run is simply a longer, moderate effort. Finally, the inclusion of cross-training in Plan A provides a valuable low-impact recovery component.
